INSERT INTO technician_commissions 
  (technicianId, clientAccountId, invoiceId, commissionRate, invoiceAmountCents, commissionAmountCents, netCommissionCents, status, commissionType, paidAt)
VALUES 
  (300001, 30001, 1, 15, 19900, 2985, 2985, 'pending', 'rep', NULL);

-- Commission for INV-2026-0003 (Dojo Flow, $932, paid) — 15% = $139.80 = 13980 cents

  (technicianId, clientAccountId, invoiceId, commissionRate, invoiceAmountCents, commissionAmountCents, netCommissionCents, status, commissionType, paidAt)
VALUES 
  (300001, 60001, 30001, 15, 93200, 13980, 13980, 'pending', 'rep', NULL);

-- Commission for INV-2026-04-006 (Dojo Flow, $932, open) — 15% = $139.80 = 13980 cents

VALUES 
  (300001, 60001, 120001, 15, 93200, 13980, 13980, 'pending', 'rep', NULL);

-- Verify
SELECT tc.id, tc.invoiceId, tc.commissionAmountCents, tc.status, ci.invoiceNumber, ca.businessName
FROM technician_commissions tc
JOIN client_invoices ci ON ci.id = tc.invoiceId
JOIN client_accounts ca ON ca.id = tc.clientAccountId
WHERE tc.technicianId = 300001;
